title: The Oath upon Mount Hermon
place: Stele of the Covenant · Threshold of Hermon
body: And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.
note: Quoted word for word from R. H. Charles, The Book of Enoch (1917), public domain; his editorial marks are left out. The tablet, its title, the place names, the chasm and the flight are game fiction, not part of 1 Enoch.
